rationale: The agent identified the user via name+ZIP and accessed their orders, but then executed order-changing writes (three returns and a cancellation) without any explicit user confirmation, violating the policy requirement to confirm before making changes. Moreover, the user only wanted to cancel the hose item if possible; the agent appears to have cancelled the entire pending order (#W2575533), which may exceed the user’s intent. The refund total calculation used six amounts while only five items were returned, and there’s no clear support tying those amounts to the tool outputs, risking inaccuracy. These issues meet fail conditions: writes without confirmation and potentially acting beyond the requested scope, with questionable final information.
